title: Excellence is preserved by finite type algebras and localization
statement: Let $R$ be an excellent commutative ring [def-exc-excellent-ring], let $A$ be a finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let $S\subseteq A$ be a multiplicative subset ($1\in S$ and $st\in S$ for $s,t\in S$). Then the localization $S^{-1}A$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is excellent. In particular $A$ is excellent by taking $S=\{1\}$.
